text: Bangladesh: 127 MN Voters, 50 Parties, 2000+ Candidates In 1st High Stake Polls Since Hasina’s FallBangladesh: 127 MN Voters, 50 Parties, 2000+ Candidates In 1st High Stake Polls Since Hasina’s Fall Bangladesh's historic Feb 12 polls pit 127M voters across 42K+ centers against 2000+ candidates from 50 parties in 1st election post-Hasina's 2024 ouster. BNP vs Jamaat-e-Islami-led 11-party alliance dominates suspended Awami League's absence amid heavy security for 300 seats.
